dedupe_keys.name: fractional order intensity measure for high confidence probabilistic seismic demand modeling of structures

description: Fractional Order Intensity Measure for High-Confidence Probabilistic Seismic Demand Modeling of Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Xiaowei Wang, Case Western Reserve University (case.edu). In performance-based earthquake engineering, probabilistic seismic demand models of structures are essential components that provide probabilistic estimates of earthquake-induced demands as a function of a variable(s) called the ground motion intensity measure (IM). Uncertainties in these models are often dependent on the IM used. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Fractional order intensity measure; structure; probabilistic seismic demand modeling; optimal intensity measure. Published 2021-05-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
